notes: No ruleset POST/PATCH/DELETE. The intended branch must be bootstrapped before enabling restrictive rules.
A creation rule would prohibit initial branch creation without an authorized bypass; an update restriction without an enrolled bypass actor can freeze all future writes.
Deletion and non_fast_forward alone do not prohibit an authorized fast-forward of stale signed contents.
required_signatures checks Git commit signature verification, not vendor OHLCV truth, key custody, entitlement, or source-clock provenance.
A GitHub Actions PR token must remain contents:read. Do not grant write/admin secrets to an unreviewed PR workflow.
